about: Reviewed withholds (FIX-LST-4): records a review found published with a wrong time base that no general rule of the time-base audit reaches. timebase_audit.apply_reviewed_withhold makes each listed record disputed (code disputed:reviewer_evidence, reason 'reviewer_evidence: <short>'), never corrected. A listed id not in the inventory, or a listed record the audit verified or corrected by any evidence, stops the audit. A listed record is never a reference for another record. Add an entry only with a review's evidence; remove it when the record's own evidence changes.

entries.short: leads 3 NOAA stations by 234-409 min; a damped canal site cannot lead
entries.reason: SFWMD West Cocohatchee canal gauge (M2 6 cm, damped to 0.27 of the coast) leads every NOAA station within 11-15 km by about -234 to -409 min. A damped inland site lags the open water; it cannot lead it by hours. Same provider and pattern as the 33 SFWMD records disputed on EST stamps.

evidence.numbers: NOAA 8725283 Little Hickory Island 11.3 km M2 -281 (ratio 0.27); 8725114 Naples Bay 14.8 km -268; 8725319 Coconut Point 15.4 km; range -234..-409 min

entries.short: inverted and shifted against EOT20; Black Sea controls agree with EOT20
entries.reason: CMEMS Burgas South: the series is inverted (sign) and shifted, so its constants predict the tide worse than nothing in a 2-cm sea. EOT20 is valid there: the IOC gauges at Igneada, Constanta (csta2) and Mangalia agree with it within 0.4 h.

entries.short: inland marsh gauge leads the open coast by 57-82 min
entries.reason: CRMS 0590 is inland of the coast, yet it leads the open-coast NOAA stations by 57-82 min; an inland site lags. Its 15-km NOAA reference (8767095) is itself inland water lagging the coast by about +221 min, against which it leads by 279 min.

evidence.numbers: 8766072 Freshwater Canal Locks 66 km -57.5 (ratio 0.77); 8768094 Calcasieu Pass 53 km -82.5 (0.75); 8764314 Eugene Island 153 km -78.0 (0.98); 8767095 8.2 km -279

entries.short: lags the open coast by only -4..+21 min though inland of a bay that lags +200-250
entries.reason: CRMS 0511 sits inland of a bay whose NOAA station (8765148) lags the open coast by +258 min and whose neighbouring records lag about +186, yet it lags the open coast by only -4 to +21 min. That is about 3.5-4 h too early for its water: a clock offset, not a tide.

entries.short: leads Little Card Sound by 212 min and USGS Manatee Bay by 308 min; SFWMD EST
entries.reason: SFWMD S-197 tailwater (M2 7 cm, K1/O1 1 cm). Against NOAA Little Card Sound (8723534) harmonic constants 7.2 km away it leads by 212.5 min, every constituent within 30 min; against USGS Manatee Bay Creek (3.3 km, another provider, same water: M2 ratio 1.06) by 308 min. Neither the agency reference's open-water lag nor its own is needed: the record leads both by over 3 h, as the rest of its family stamped in EST.

entries.short: about +60 min late against NOAA's own harcon, official predictions and EOT20
entries.reason: NOAA Kivalina, Alaska (M2 7 cm), the station's only set. Its constants put it about an hour late against three independent references at the same site: NOAA's published harmonic constants for this station (a 29-day analysis of September 2003, inside the record), NOAA's official high/low predictions for the station, and EOT20. The audit had no comparator for it (not in the pool), so the declared UTC base was kept unchecked.

The owner delegated the decision to withhold it.
